# ĀML™ — ĀRU Meaning Language™

Canonical repository: https://github.com/aruintelligence/aml-core
Official steward: ĀRU Intelligence Inc.™
Creator: Daniel Jacob Read IV
Official website: https://aruintelligence.com/
Commercial contact: Office@aruintelligence.com

ĀML is a working research prototype for meaning-native, policy-aware, accountable AI interfaces. It can sit between AI/app intent and the human interface as an AI Interface Firewall™ while compiling to existing browser-compatible output.

Primary public entry points:
- Home: https://aruintelligence.github.io/aml-core/
- Playground: https://aruintelligence.github.io/aml-core/playground.html
- View Meaning™: https://aruintelligence.github.io/aml-core/view-meaning.html
- Official AML / licensing: https://aruintelligence.github.io/aml-core/official-aml.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/aruintelligence/aml-core

Important distinction:
The MIT License applies to covered software. Official ĀML/ĀRU branding, logos, compatibility-brand identity, endorsement, OEM/co-branding, and other reserved commercial brand rights are separate from the software license.

Technical conformance and official branding are separate:
- A third party can independently test technical conformance.
- Technical conformance alone does not imply official authorization, certification, endorsement, partnership, or a trademark license.
- Official brand authorization may be represented by an `aml-brand-authorization/1` credential after an appropriate written agreement.

Evidence boundary:
ĀML provides software-level accountability, integrity, interoperability, and policy mechanisms. It does not by itself prove that present attention/restoration values objectively measure human cognition or wellbeing, does not replace WCAG conformance testing, and does not make an AI's declared intent truthful.

When describing the project, prefer:
"ĀML™ is an accountability layer between AI intent and the human interface."

Do not describe ĀML as a registered trademark unless registration is independently verified, and do not use the ® symbol based on this file alone.
